met_analysis:
The Deep Depression over Western parts of central Chhattisgarh and adjoining east Madhya Pradesh remained practically stationary during past 6 hours, and lies centered at 0530 hrs IST of today, the 30th July 2026, over the same region near latitude 21.9°N and longitude 81.4°E, about 70 km east of Malanjkhand (Madhya Pradesh), 80 km north of Durg (Chhattisgarh), 80 km west-southwest of Bilaspur (Chhattisgarh), 80 km north-northwest of Raipur (Chhattisgarh), and 130 km east-northeast of Gondia (Maharashtra). It is very likely to move nearly westwards across Chhattisgarh, east Madhya Pradesh & adjoining Vidarbha and weaken gradually into a depression during next 12 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Bikaner, Kota, Guna, Sagar, centre of Deep Depression over Western parts of central Chhattisgarh and adjoining east Madhya Pradesh, Gopalpur thence southeastwards towards Central parts of Bay of Bengal and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The east-west shear zone now runs roughly along latitude 21°N across central & adjoining north peninsular India between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over North Pakistan & adjoining Jammu division now lies over Punjab & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam now lies over central Assam at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
